description: Places de stationnement roses is a dataset listed in Ville-d'avray open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Mairie de Ville-d'Avray. Localisation des places de stationnement pour les personnes à mobilité réduite (PMR) non porteuses d'une carte « CMI Stationnement » ou « CES » et limitées à 30 minutes. Coverage: Ville-d'Avray. The portal files it under Accessibilité, Stationnement, Transports, Déplacements, Mobilité. Its keywords are PMR, Ville d'Avray, Linéaires de stationnement. The portal shows 8 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-01-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ouverte (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-villedavray-fr-portal.
